decisions.reason: The pixelation criterion applies specifically to the full-page chapter illustrations and does not change the interior layout's paperback format or trim-size requirements.
Image pixelation does not affect the hierarchy, capitalization, or formatting of chapter headings.
The chapter-image rendering-quality decision does not change table-of-contents numbering or its update timing.
The source concerns full-page chapter images, not copyright-page content or layout.
The pixelation check for chapter illustrations does not resolve or alter the separate uncertainty about the interior title page.
The source does not affect the book title's typography or literal newline-artifact constraint.
In the supplied context, 'they' refers to the full-page chapter images rather than the paperback cover, so no cover requirement changes.
Chapter-image rendering quality does not change the requested back matter or author copy.
The image pixelation criterion is unrelated to manuscript prose editing or the approved passage revisions.
